caption: The drawing depicts a composition centered within a thick, black, geometric border shaped loosely like an upside-down "T," with yellow and red diagonal stripes along the border edges. Within this border, a symmetrical floral arrangement arises from a green vase at the base, with stems and leaves curving outward. The flowers and leaves are stylized, rendered primarily in yellow and red, with thick green stems and outlining. The main central flower has yellow petals outlined in red, while the side flowers are red and similarly outlined. Striped and dotted decorative accents in matching colors (red, yellow, green) surround the flowers inside the black border. At the top center of the design, outside the vase, a green bird is depicted in profile, facing left, sitting atop the border. Across the bottom, beneath the base of the border, runs a horizontal strip patterned with repeating shapes and stripes in yellow, green, and red. The background outside the main design is plain off-white.
title: Study for Proposed Portfolio "Decorated Chests of Rural Pennsylvania"
